concerns.text: FR-001 mandates downloading 'Persona-Chat' and 'EmpatheticDialogues'. The plan explicitly restricts the pipeline to 'HCI_P2' only (Section 'Technical Context' and 'Dataset Constraint'), stating: 'The pipeline will exclusively use HCI_P2... to ensure reproducibility'. No plan element (phase, task, or data model) addresses the download or processing of Persona-Chat or EmpatheticDialogues. This is an unbacked FR.

User Story 1 acceptance scenario 1 requires: 'Given Persona-Chat and EmpatheticDialogues are accessible... Then both datasets are stored locally'. The plan's 'Dataset Constraint' section explicitly rejects this scenario, stating: 'Persona-Chat and EmpatheticDialogues lack verified URLs... Plan Decision: The pipeline will exclusively use HCI_P2'. The plan does not provide a mechanism to satisfy this user story if the datasets were accessible, nor does it propose a spec change to remove the requirement.
